issue.title: Highlight the selected clan member's dependency cone (WAITS ON / BLOCKS) in the Agents tab
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by sase-1lc.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) and listed as a v2 non-goal in the
epic plan `plan:202610/clan_waves_in_agents_tab.md` (Non-goals: "A dependency-cone
highlight for the selected member (`WAITS ON` / `BLOCKS`)").

Epic sase-1lc shipped clan waves in the Agents tab: a wave gutter, pips, a live WAVES
ladder in the clan Summary card, and wave-divided JUMP legend cells. Those surfaces show
which *layer* a member is in, but not *which specific members* the selected member waits
on or blocks. The ladder's FULLY_EXPANDED level prints `.5  waits on .3 ▶ · .4 ⏳`, but
only inside the Summary card and only for predecessors.

Proposal: when a clan member row is selected, highlight its dependency cone — its
transitive predecessors (`WAITS ON`) and transitive dependents (`BLOCKS`) — in the agent
list and/or the clan JUMP legend, using the per-member `predecessor` data that
`project_clan_tree` already attaches (`ClanWaveSummary.members[*].predecessors`). No new
persistence or render-path I/O should be needed.

Design questions for the worker: which surfaces get the highlight (list rows, JUMP cells,
ladder), whether it is transitive or direct-only, how it composes with selection and
in-flight tints, and the cache-key additions it needs (see `sase memory read tui.md`).

task_type_fields.proposal: Highlight the selected clan member's transitive predecessors (WAITS ON) and dependents (BLOCKS) using the per-member predecessor data project_clan_tree already attaches.
